newsitem.title: UK: NWE gasoline shuffles lower with easier U.S number.
newsitem.headline: NWE gasoline shuffles lower with easier U.S number.

text.p: NWE gasoline was softer on Friday after heavy NYMEX falls yesterday. The focus continued to be U.S demand.
Traders said midafternoon crack spread buying helped U.S gasoline recover, but by late Friday the tone was easier.
Eurograde barges traded down to $218 fob AR a tonne with $220 and $222 also heard. Talk that $224 was concluded could not be confirmed.
Icy conditions in the ARA region was hampering the movement of product and limiting the amount of physical buying, local traders said.

Tankers were still being sought to take gasoline to the U.S since the arb remains open despite high freight rates. Up to 25 tankers have been fixed over the last week to carry one million tonnes transatlantic.
Some traders said more was expected to head westwards next week. "I think another 100,000 to 200,000 tonnes would not be surprising.
